scientific_integrity: A complete parameter-uniform proof is given with finite computational cross-checks; finite computation is not the basis for the infinite result. Publication priority and external validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Standard Proth semigroups only; no genus or generalized-base claim. The proof uses the established full-family Apéry/greedy theorem. Residual possibility of an unindexed equivalent prior formula.
title: Exact Frobenius numbers for all nontrivial odd-parameter Proth semigroups
